newsitem.title: USA: Guidant's Ventak AV II DR ICDs implanted.
newsitem.headline: Guidant's Ventak AV II DR ICDs implanted.

text.p: Guidant Corp said the first two implants of its Ventak AV II DR implantable defibrillators were accomplished in Europe.
The Ventak AV II DR is the world's first implantable defibrillator system to incorporate adaptive-rate pacing, Guidant said.
The first implants of the device took place Friday in Germany, said the medical devices maker.

An implantable defibrillator is an electronic device implanted in the body and wired to the heart to keep it from beating too fast. The Ventak AV II DR treats patients with rapid heart arrhythmias who also need pacing therapy.
The Ventak AV II DR also can discriminate between ventricular rhythms that are life threatening and non life-threatening arrhythmias, Guidant said.
"This new product is the first in a series of downsized defibrillators that we plan to be launching in markets around the world," Guidant said.
